name: Morioh High
desc:
Present Day, Morioh, Japan.

A school life game where pretty much anything can happen.

Attend classes, make friends (or enemies lol), build relationships, join groups, and explore Morioh High. The NPCs aren't just there for decoration either. You can interact with them!

You can try living a normal school life! (but knowing this is Morioh, that probably won't last very long) ゴゴゴ

llm.loop: attend school in Morioh -> interact with NPCs and players -> roll for a stand -> fight
llm.objectives: live school life in Morioh and get a good stand
llm.instructions: attend classes, make friends or enemies, build relationships, join groups, interact with NPCs
unique: JoJo Part 4 school-life roleplay with interactive NPCs plus stand rolling
llm.thumbnails: anime art of a white-haired character with a golden stand and a blue-glowing fighter with menacing katakana
llm.complexity_notes: school map, NPC interaction systems, stand abilities and combat; unclear depth
